'''PK-4''' was a [[PK-series worker droid/Legends|PK-series worker droid]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]] and was part of the [[New Droids' Rights Movement]], a group of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against [[Species/Legends|organic]] life forms throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
PK-4 was originally created for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], though his short, humorous scene, while scripted and included in early cuts, was left out of the final version. Despite this, his computer-generated model was cloned and inserted into the background of several scenes to create a small army of PKs. In addition, several [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] sources referred to PK-series worker droids as PK-4s. His puppet went on to inspire the design of the [[SP-4 analysis droid]], which was originally identified as a PK-4 [[analysis droid]] in an early draft of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. However, the SP-4's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry mistakenly claimed that the puppet was originally developed for ''Attack of the Clones'', making no mention of PK-4.
